parsed.rationale: Although both records carry is_sample_app=false, the second participating record lives at 'Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift', which is physically nested under the Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/ directory tree — a canonical sample-app location. The decision rules treat any record under Examples/ as a sample-app-mirror restraint marker regardless of the flag value. Lifting the production implementation from 'Shared/DebugPanel/Sources/DebugPanel/DebugMetricsProvider.swift' into a shared location to satisfy this cluster would couple production DebugPanel semantics to a demonstration harness, which is the exact anti-pattern the restraint rule is designed to prevent. The duplication is intentional: the sample app carries its own local copy of measureMemoryUsage so it can run standalone without a hard dependency on the DebugPanel package.
